title: Twenty-five thousand uses, and a handoff

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Twenty-five thousand uses on the GPT Store. For a tool that started because someone was tired of dragging boxes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Dragging boxes? That's a very specific annoyance.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is. At school, UML is how people share an idea. And Antoine built this diagram tool so he'd stop dragging boxes and arrows around in Lucidchart.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So you describe the diagram in chat and it draws it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's the picture on the page: from a chat prompt to editable PlantUML, generated through M C P in the conversation.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Editable is the key word, I guess. You're not stuck with an image.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right, you get PlantUML you can keep tweaking. The tool reached twenty-five thousand uses on the GPT Store, which is the headline of the post.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Here's the interesting part. Antoine says he'd like someone else to carry the app forward, and he's glad to pass on what he learned building it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: More or less. The repository is called D two C OpenAI Plugin, and the page links both the repo and an earlier write-up of the plugin.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Short post, but a clear ask.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Build a tool to scratch your own itch, watch twenty-five thousand uses pile up, then look for the next maintainer.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The written page has the chat screenshot and links to the project note.
